% hyperref's \phantomsection as the first thing in a list, before its
% first \bibitem, with the references' line in the table of contents. In
% the PDF, the line's link goes to the top of the list. On the page, the
% line links the heading right above the list. A \phantomsection right
% after an \item has its anchor in the item.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
\section{One}
Text \cite{x}, and item \ref{a}.
\begin{enumerate}
  \item First.
  \item \phantomsection\label{a} Second.
\end{enumerate}
\begin{thebibliography}{9}
  \phantomsection
  \addcontentsline{toc}{section}{\refname}
  \bibitem{x} A. Author. Title.
\end{thebibliography}
\end{document}
